attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow validates successfully. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ft_003
steps:
  - id: receive_image
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      method: POST
      endpoint: /api/camera/capture
      accept: image/*
    output: raw_image

  - id: validate_image
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{raw_image}}"
      rules:
        format:
          - image/jpeg
          - image/png
          - image/heic
        max_size_mb: 10
    output: validated_image

  - id: handle_invalid_image
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_failure: validate_image
      action: notify_and_terminate
      message: "Invalid image format or size. Please retake the photo."

  - id: call_vision_api
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      method: POST
      url: "{{env.AI_VISION_API_URL}}/extract-nutrition"
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{env.AI_VISION_API_KEY}}"
        Content-Type: application/octet-stream
      body: "{{validated_image}}"
      timeout_seconds: 30
    output: vision_response

  - id: retry_vision_api
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step_id: call_vision_api
      max_retries: 2
      backoff_seconds: 3

  - id: parse_nutrition_data
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{vision_response}}"
      fields:
        - calories
        - fat_g
        - carbohydrates_g
        - protein_g
        - fiber_g
        - sugar_g
        - sodium_mg
        - serving_size
        - serving_unit
        - product_name
    output: nutrition_data

  - id: transform_nutrition
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: "{{nutrition_data}}"
      mapping:
        calories: "{{nutrition_data.calories}}"
        fat: "{{nutrition_data.fat_g}}"
        carbs: "{{nutrition_data.carbohydrates_g}}"
        protein: "{{nutrition_data.protein_g}}"
        fiber: "{{nutrition_data.fiber_g}}"
        sugar: "{{nutrition_data.sugar_g}}"
        sodium: "{{nutrition_data.sodium_mg}}"
        serving_size: "{{nutrition_data.serving_size}}"
        serving_unit: "{{nutrition_data.serving_unit}}"
        product_name: "{{nutrition_data.product_name}}"
    output: structured_nutrition

  - id: validate_plausible_ranges
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: "{{structured_nutrition}}"
      rules:
        - field: calories
          condition: "between"
          min: 0
          max: 2000
        - field: fat
          condition: "between"
          min: 0
          max: 200
        - field: carbs
          condition: "between"
          min: 0
          max: 500
        - field: protein
          condition: "between"
          min: 0
          max: 300
        - field: serving_size
          condition: "greater_than"
          value: 0
    output: validation_result

  - id: flag_implausible_values
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "{{validation_result.has_violations}}"
      on_true: notify_implausible
      on_false: format_food_entry

  - id: notify_implausible
    op: notify_user
    params:
      channel: in_app
      title: "Nutrition Data Review Needed"
      message: "Some extracted values seem implausible and have been flagged. Please review carefully before confirming."
      data:
        flagged_fields: "{{validation_result.violations}}"

  - id: format_food_entry
    op: format_output
    params:
      template: food_entry_form
      data:
        product_name: "{{structured_nutrition.product_name}}"
        calories: "{{structured_nutrition.calories}}"
        fat: "{{structured_nutrition.fat}}"
        carbs: "{{structured_nutrition.carbs}}"
        protein: "{{structured_nutrition.protein}}"
        fiber: "{{structured_nutrition.fiber}}"
        sugar: "{{structured_nutrition.sugar}}"
        sodium: "{{structured_nutrition.sodium}}"
        serving_size: "{{structured_nutrition.serving_size}}"
        serving_unit: "{{structured_nutrition.serving_unit}}"
        flagged: "{{validation_result.has_violations}}"
        flagged_fields: "{{validation_result.violations}}"
        requires_confirmation: true
    output: food_entry_form

  - id: await_user_confirmation
    op: wait_for_condition
    params:
      condition: "{{food_entry_form.user_confirmed}}"
      timeout_seconds: 300
      on_timeout: terminate
    output: user_decision

  - id: log_scan_event
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: food_label_scanned
      details:
        product_name: "{{structured_nutrition.product_name}}"
        confirmed: "{{user_decision.confirmed}}"
        flagged: "{{validation_result.has_violations}}"
